memo: Base: Ahmed Berat Ozer 'casmi26-v22-n1-challenger' (his v15-n1a + flexonafft's N1 challenger, casmi26-closing-the-evidence-gap v47; the same step is dmitriigluzdov's v16 at public LB 0.464), kernels/e3/base_v22.ipynb, unchanged except the cells marked ours. This version: v22 base + own COCONUT (as e3v22oc-1, CPU 0.449) + ours_icepar (new, ours): on the CPU kernel ICEBERG runs in 4 parallel runner processes (1 thread each, chunks of 500 predictions) instead of one 4-thread process, same 5,400 s budget. Measured on a 4-core container: 5.2 vs 3.3 predictions/s. The CPU kernels of 10-22 reached only about a third of the hidden ICEBERG jobs (CPU v22oc 0.449 vs GPU v15oc 0.457). Hypothesis: LB > 0.449 (more molecules ICEBERG-reranked), toward the GPU level. build.py v22icp base=v22 ownco=1 lfrag=1 icepar=4 cpu.
